title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Item
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Item . A tangible object which can be uniquely identified, for example with a GTIN in the form of a barcode/QR/RFID tag. An item can be the result of an organization's production process (outflow of objects/goods) or a uniquely identifiable material (inflow of objects/supplies). Each item is created in exactly one ItemBatch, and can itself recursively consist of other items (sub-assemblies). Subclass of the external saref:FeatureOfInterest class (SAREF core).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Item'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

belongsToItemBatch.description: Relationship. The item batch in which this item was created (inverse of ItemBatch's containsItem). An item is created in exactly one item batch. Target model: 'ItemBatch'.

hasSerialNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/hasSerialNumber'. The serial number of this item, unique per item (at most one).

hasIdentifier.description: Relationship. The unique identifier of this item (e.g. GTIN, IRDI, UUID). Target model: 'ID'.

consistsOf.description: Relationship. An item can recursively consist of other items (sub-assemblies). Target model: 'Item'.
